newsitem.title: USA: Sears files $4.5 bln shelf offering of debt.
newsitem.headline: Sears files $4.5 bln shelf offering of debt.

text.p: Sears Roebuck Acceptance Corp, a financing unit of Sears, Roebuck and Co. filed Tuesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf offering of up to $4.5 billion in debt securities.
The offering totals $5,794,750,000 when combined with previously registered debt securities.
Proceeds from the sale of the securities will be added to the company's general funds and initially will be used to reduce short-term debt.
No underwriters were named in the shelf offering.
